newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ausdrill increases mine rigs in Chile.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ausdrill increases mine rigs in Chile.

text.p: Mining services company Ausdrill Ltd said on Monday it has more than doubled its fleet of exploration drill rigs in Chile to take advantage of increasing exploration work.
Five additional rigs have been transported to Chile, bringing the fleet to nine, the company said.
Three of the rigs come from Ausdrill's existing fleet and two are new, the company said.
One feature of the Chilean mining sector is that the size of new mining contracts has been rising in the last several months, Ausdrill said.
"Chile is the core of our operations and we are looking to build up a strong fleet of drilling rigs in the country," Ausdrill's managing director, Ron Sayers, said in a statement.
